topic.title: How much time does an agent get per round/game?

messages.content: I was wondering what the timelimit for making a decision per round or per game is. I read that it was 600s but I couldn't verify it.
messages.rawMarkdown:
I was wondering what the timelimit for making a decision per round or per game is.

messages.content: 600s per game - no time limit per move.
